notes: Refined existing stories for completeness; no new IDs created.

change_log.value: Expanded schema to include filters (insurance, radius), pagination, and strict response shape (scores, geo metadata, NUCC codes).
change_log.note: Close schema gaps for API contract

change_log.value: Explicit tool_router allowlist integration and FastAPI endpoint contract alignment with Pydantic models.
Added edge case coverage: empty results, fallback-only scenarios, and geo boundary conditions.

stories.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty, filters like insurance and radius, pagination) and outputs (ranked providers, scores, geo metadata, NUCC codes) ensuring strict compatibility with tool_router and FindCareFacade.

stories.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
stories.description: Implement MongoDB Atlas vector search with deterministic NUCC taxonomy fallback, including ranking, geo filtering (state/city/county via FIPS), and normalized result scoring.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade and API
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into FindCareFacade and expose through tool_router (allowlisted tool) and FastAPI endpoints, ensuring strict schema adherence and tool-use compatibility.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Identification and Embedding Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate specialty_service (regex + vector NUCC mapping) and embedding_client to support hybrid semantic + taxonomy search with query expansion.

stories.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit tests for ranking, fallback, geo filtering, and edge cases (empty results, fallback-only scenarios, geo boundaries) plus integration tests validating full flow from tool_router → FindCareFacade → provider_search_service including hybrid search behavior.
